text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "So, Grass-san. About this afternoon—"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aah, found King-chan! Everyone, over here, 
over here!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Urara-senpai. Is this person the 
ear-cleaning master...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...An earpick master?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's right! King-chan is really good at 
cleaning ears!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They went swish-swish-swish on my ears, 
and it felt so fluffy and dreamy, I 
totally melted!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...! Could I, could I please ask for 
one too!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh... It's just my usual routine care! 
Right, Grass-san?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why bring that up to me...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because it really is just normal 
grooming. After giving a light 
brushing..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Rub it gently with a tightly wrung towel. 
For Urara-san, cold water makes her jump 
up, so I make sure to use warm water 
instead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Once you've wiped them all over, pat dry 
with a soft towel. Next, take a cotton 
swab made specifically for inside the 
ears...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...My, how polite.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeh?! Isn't that normal?! Urara-san 
always tries to skip steps, so I keep 
having to teach her over and over, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your ears are vital organs, after all. Not 
just for hearing, but for your sense of 
balance too. Winning a race starts with 
proper ear care.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, as expected of King-chan~. However—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Graaass! Have you seen my earpick?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you've lost it again? Just how many 
times has this been?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... How many times has it been now?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, losing things once a month is 
completely normal! Please lend me your 
earpick, Grass!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eep... J-Just kidding, of course-desu... 
I'll go find a tree branch to poke around 
with instead-desu...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's not the point! El!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Though there are some girls who leave 
me wondering how anyone could treat things 
so carelessly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Grass and King *desu*?! 
There are other Umamusume around too... 
Are you setting up a match?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. Everyone's lining up 
because they want King-chan to clean their 
ears!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Why don't you line up over there 
too, El? They say the feeling is heavenly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! King, King! Clean El's ears too, 
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Even you, El-san?! Seriously... 
geez!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to grab the equipment right now! 
Everyone, stay right there!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...If words will not sway them, then we 
shall peel away their pride like the skin 
of a sweet mochi.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If El gets a taste of quality just once, 
it might change her perspective on 
maintenance.
